meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把问题和外部提交有序分流，生成现成的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护活跃的仓库，每天要处理大量问题和外部贡献的改动。
copy.tagline_en: Triage issues and external PRs in order, producing ready-to-use task briefs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an active repository and deal with many issues and external contributions regularly.

howto.what: 使用 /triage 命令后，Claude 会读取指定的 issue 或 PR，归类为 bug 或 enhancement，并分配状态（如 needs-info、ready-for-agent 等）。它会验证问题是否成立，必要时追问，最后产出任务简报或分诊笔记。所有分诊期间发布的内容都会附带 AI 生成免责声明。
howto.when: 仅当维护者发出 /triage 命令并说明意图时触发，例如查看需关注问题、指定 issue/PR、调整其状态等。不会自动触发。

say.text: /triage 显示需要我注意的事项

howto.what_en: On /triage, Claude reads an issue/PR, categorizes it (bug/enhancement), assigns a state, verifies claims, and posts agent briefs or triage notes. Comments carry an AI disclaimer.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when the maintainer explicitly invokes `/triage` and describes what they want — e.g., show attention-needed items, inspect an issue/PR, or move it to a state. Not auto-triggered.

say_en.note: Lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and re-check items.
Reads it and gives a category/state recommendation.
Applies state and asks about writing an agent brief.
